summary: check-protected-vms.sh now takes only the plan JSON and fails on any prd VM delete or replace, including ["delete","create"]. All three jobs call it that way, and the drift job no longer swallows its result. The drift job's description leads with each VM destroy Terraform refused under prevent_destroy, then the guard's verdicts. Evidence is an offline Terraform repro in the iac sidecar, shellcheck and a Python port of driftSummary; the named root gate runs nothing (close-out N1). The operator's rollout order is close-out A1.
